supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of temp.rwong at 13:45:12 UTC by greta.lund.
A network logon for greta.lund from 10.53.10.24 was recorded shortly before creation; that address is associated with WS-GLUND-01 in the supplied activity.
The account was added to Externals by greta.lund under the same logon ID used for its creation.

The account name and its recorded Externals membership match the organization's stated temporary-account procedure, and greta.lund is authorized to create domain accounts. The available evidence therefore supports a benign disposition for the alerted activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records do not include a help-desk request or other business justification for creating temp.rwong.
The records show the Externals group addition but do not provide a complete account group-membership or privilege audit.
The evidence does not show subsequent use of temp.rwong.
claims_not_established: Whether the account creation was tied to a specific approved request.
Whether temp.rwong had any additional group memberships or privileges not shown in these records.
Whether the account was used after creation.
unrelated_findings: WS-GLUND-01 activity includes browsing to Salesforce; this is outside the alerted account creation and is not listed among the supplied approved services (T178-00004, T178-00009).
WS-GLUND-01 activity includes an attempted visit to the AWS console, which received a proxy 504 response; this is unrelated to the account creation (T178-00021, T178-00034).

Dropbox and Slack processes started under greta.lund, and the supplied inventory does not list these services as approved; handle separately without treating them as evidence that temp.rwong creation was malicious (T178-00026, T178-00028, T178-00029, T178-00031).
WS-GLUND-01 connected to drive.google.com, an unapproved cloud-storage service per the supplied inventory; this is separate from the alerted activity (T178-00038, T178-00039).

UserAssist records on WS-GLUND-01 show PowerShell and Firefox execution history; these records do not establish a connection to the temp.rwong creation (T178-00001, T178-00002, T178-00003, T178-00045).
